displayName: 约翰·华生（BBC版） John Watson (BBC Sherlock)
description: Unofficial John Watson fan-art companion inspired by the fictional doctor in BBC Sherlock. Original animation features notebook writing, carefully presenting two cups of tea, securing a loose pen, checking a pouch of folded cloth and a short controlled hop. The oatmeal sweater and simplified casual clothes are creative adaptations. Independently drawn fan art; no medical procedure, official affiliation or authorization is claimed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
